title: Desert island and Utopia: a place to work
summary: Johnston asks Gil's desert-island and Utopia questions. Gil says his Utopia is a large room full of instruments.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Well that sort of puts the group together. You are, I was wondering, I think I told you about Alan Sherman's question on listening rooms, which comes up periodically.
Oh, if you were on a desert island?

Yes, if you were on a desert island, yes. (LAUGHTER). Now these are the musicians you do have. Are there some that you would have, that you would prefer taking with you to a desert island? No, I'll put that question another way. No, I was going to ask, if you were going to be on a desert island, this is more like Alan Sherman, what albums would you take with you? To listen to. The other question that was my own, which is, especially coming out of literature I would think of Utopia, of a Utopia. So that if you were going to have your own musical Utopia which musicians would you have with you? If you could just without any restraint whatsoever?
Well I'm not pausing because I can't think of the musicians. I'm pausing because of
the Utopia idea. Not that it wouldn't, well Utopia brings up a whole different picture to me. But just to play the game I would just soon have the band I have now.

Well I don't think it's really a game when you think about it seriously. Because I think that all of us who work in the arts have ideas from time to time of what we would really like to have to do our jobs the way we would like to do them. Our jobs the way we would like to do them.
And I certainly know that even I as a theater historian think of the kind of staff that I need and what I could really accomplish if I had that staff. It's that kind of Utopia, it's not ............

Places is the thing you, you maybe this place is okay for you. The first thing I think of when I think of Utopia would be for me to have a place to work. A great big room full of all the instruments that I wanted. That's the first thing that I'd want. A good grand piano, a good electric (piano?) and my synthesizer equipment. All kinds of drums and guitars and things like that. I'd just have that all around in a big room and then I'd move from there.
People could come by then. That's the first thing (I think of as Utopia?).
